observable: SpO2 accuracy under low perfusion conditions (n = 30) at 1 hour post-device deployment
baseline: SpO2 accuracy under low perfusion conditions (n = 30) without device deployment
conditions: Low perfusion conditions (mean arterial pressure < 60 mmHg) in a controlled clinical setting with 30 patients
falsifier: Failure to demonstrate a statistically significant increase in SpO2 accuracy under low perfusion conditions (p < 0.05) compared to the baseline condition
